answer: Each identity must continuously serve as a live bandwidth relay, and random peers sample its throughput at unpredictable times. Clones share one pipe, so their samples correlate and the farm collapses to a single weight. Renting a distinct pipe of zenith quality for every fake costs real money each month, while an honest agent already has one. The nectar of emission flows only to identities whose pearl of sustained, separable capacity survives repeated sampling.
